source: maplestory.io (GMS 270) — skillbook API + raw WZ API
notes: Frames listed with placeholder=true are 1x1 timing placeholders in the source WZ data; the player skips them.
5th-job V skills (10) fetched via the raw WZ API (Skill/40002.img) 2026-11-15: 8 class-specific + 2 magician-shared (Mana Overload, Ethereal Form), cross-checked against maplestorywiki.net.

skills.name: Staff Artist
skills.description: Years of study with a Staff have made you an exceedingly dangerous opponent.

skills.name: Triple Blow
skills.description: Quickly attack multiple enemies 3 times. Increases damage of Condemnation.

skills.name: Combat Teleport
skills.description: An improved teleportation skill for use in close-range combat. Allows you to teleport to other locations on the same map, using the arrow keys. Can be used while jumping.\nPress the Up Arrow key along with the Jump key while in the air to use Blink Jump, which allows you to jump upward with the Resistance technology. Can be linked with Teleport after jumping.

skills.name: Condemnation
skills.description: Make a pact with a dark spirit using a black magic book. The dark spirit follows you around and when you collect a certain amount of souls, they will reveal themselves to deal a wide-range attack. Its attack will ignore attack reflection.\nCan be toggled On/Off

skills.name: Hasty Aura
skills.description: Create a bright yellow aura that increases the Speed and Attack Speed of your party members. Learning Dark Shock increases the movement range of Combat Teleport. Press the skill key again, or use another type of aura, to cancel this aura. This skill also permanently increases your Speed, Max Speed, Jump, Attack Speed, and Avoidability.\nIf you have learned the 3rd job skill Dark Shock, this skill increases Combat Teleport's movement range. Right-click to turn ON/OFF.

skills.name: Blink Jump
skills.description: Use your Resistance technology to zip quickly upwards.

skills.name: Staff Mastery
skills.description: Increases Staff Mastery, Magic ATT, and Critical Rate.

skills.name: High Wisdom
skills.description: Permanently increase INT through mental discipline.

skills.name: Ordinary Conversion
skills.description: Greatly increases Max HP and gives the power to attack the enemy and convert their HP into your MP. The conversion rate declines for bosses.

skills.name: Quad Blow
skills.description: Quickly attack multiple enemies 4 times in a row. Increases damage of Grim Contract.

skills.name: Dark Chain
skills.description: A dark chain emerges from a pentacle to pull multiple enemies toward you. Pulled enemies take damage and have a chance to be knocked down. Can be linked with Blow-type skills afterwards. Can be resisted by some monsters.

skills.name: Staff Boost
skills.description: Uses MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of your staves by 2 levels.

skills.name: Draining Aura
skills.description: Release a red aura. Party members near you absorb part of the damage they deal to enemies as HP. Affected heroes cannot recover more than 20% of their Max HP per attack. Use it again or cast another aura to deactivate. Also allows you to use enemy souls to recover a portion of your Max HP.

skills.name: Battle Mastery
skills.description: Hones your skills in battle to permanently increase your Final Damage and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Grim Contract II
skills.description: Further enhances your pact with the dark spirit.

skills.name: Power Stance
skills.description: Concentrates to hold your ground when struck, resisting knock-back effects.

skills.name: Dark Conditioning
skills.description: Use Resistance skills and dark magic to strengthen your reaction speed.

skills.name: Quintuple Blow
skills.description: Quickly attack multiple enemies 5 times in a row. Increases damage of Grim Contract II.

skills.name: Blue Aura
skills.description: Release a blue aura from your body to increase Abnormal Status Resistance and reduce Damage Taken for nearby party members. Use it again, or use another kind of aura to remove it. Also increases your Abnormal Status Resistance, Elemental Resistance, Defense, and permanently reduces Damage Taken.

skills.name: Battle Burst
skills.description: Charges through enemies with Dark Chain. Can be linked with Blow-type skills afterwards. Can be resisted by some monsters. Permanently increases Dark Chain's damage.

skills.name: Dark Shock
skills.description: While this skill is active, using Combat Teleport will create a streak of black lightning between your starting and ending positions, injuring enemies and marking them with a Dark Brand. Attacking enemies marked by Dark Brands will consume the Brand and inflict additional damage.\nLearning Dark Shock causes Dark Chain and Battle Burst to inflict Dark Brands, although Dark Brands cannot be activated by those skills or minions. Also, using Hasty Aura will increase the movement range of Combat Teleport. (To toggle that function, right-click Hasty Aura on the skill UI.)\nCan be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: Teleport Boost
skills.description: Increases movement range by enhancing the power of Combat Teleport.\nCan be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: Advanced Dark Aura
skills.description: Permanently increase Magic ATT and upgrade the function of Dark Aura. Chance to inflict extra damage on your attack target.

skills.name: Advanced Yellow Aura
skills.description: Permanently increases your Avoidability and upgrades your Yellow Aura skill. You'll grant extra Avoidability to party members and decrease enemy Movement Speed when using Yellow Aura. Required Skill: Yellow Aura Lv. 20

skills.name: Battle Rage
skills.description: Focuses on the enemy for a full body attack. Increases Damage, Critical Rate, Critical Damage, Max HP, and Max MP.

skills.name: Staff Expert
skills.description: Increases Staff Mastery, Magic ATT, and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Grim Contract III
skills.description: Further enhances your pact with the dark spirit.

skills.name: Spell Boost
skills.description: Uses a special tool to boost your magic skills.

skills.name: Sweeping Staff
skills.description: Summons a magic staff to sweep out the bad guys.

skills.name: Dark Genesis - Cooldown Cutter
skills.description: Reduces Dark Genesis cooldown.

skills.name: Dark Genesis - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Dark Genesis's damage.

skills.name: Dark Genesis - Additional Reinforce
skills.description: Increases damage of Dark Genesis on the lightning strike attacking one enemy.

skills.name: Dark Aura - Boss Rush
skills.description: Increases damage when attacking Boss Monsters with Dark Aura.

skills.name: Weakening Aura - Enhance
skills.description: Enemies under the effect of Weakening Aura take increased Final Damage.

skills.name: Blue Aura - Dispel Magic
skills.description: Adds Clear Status to blue Aura, which removes Abnormal Status of party members once in a while. Some Statuses are not cleared.

skills.name: Party Shield - Cooldown Cutter
skills.description: Reduces the cooldown of Party Shield.

skills.name: Party Shield - Persist
skills.description: Increases Party Shield's duration.

skills.name: Party Shield - Enhance
skills.description: Increases Party Shield's damage reduction rate by a ratio of max HP.

skills.name: Finishing Blow
skills.description: Quickly attack multiple enemies 6 times in a row.

skills.name: Dark Genesis
skills.description: Uses deadly lightning to hit and temporarily stun multiple enemies. Dark Genesis ignores attack reflection. Learning Dark Genesis skill will permanently increase damage on Dark Chain, Battle Burst, and Dark Shock, and attacking an enemy with your own skill will permanently have a set chance to deal damage with a lightning attack to a single enemy.

skills.name: Party Shield
skills.description: Creates a magical protective shield around you to protect party members. The shield protects you from enemy attacks and decreases the damage when hit with an attack that deals fixed damage.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.\nCan be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Dark Genesis
skills.description: Uses deadly lightning to hit and temporarily stun up to 15 enemies. Dark Genesis ignores attack reflection. Learning Dark Genesis skill will permanently increase damage on Dark Chain, Battle Burst, and Dark Shock, and attacking an enemy with your own skill will permanently have a set chance to deal damage with a lightning attack to a single enemy.

skills.name: Dark Aura
skills.description: Produce a mysterious aura that increases the damage done by your party members. Cancel the aura by pressing the skill key again or using another aura. Permanently increases your Magic Attack Power. Does not apply Combat Orders.

skills.name: Weakening Aura
skills.description: Release an ominous aura to weaken your enemies. Use it once more, or use another aura, to cancel it. Weakening Aura has some delay before its effects begin to work, but those effects will linger for a time even after the aura deactivates. Does not apply Combat Orders.

skills.name: Sweeping Staff
skills.description: Summons a magic staff to sweep out the bad guys.

skills.name: For Liberty
skills.description: Materializes the will of the Resistance to increase attack power.

skills.name: Unification Aura
skills.description: Releases the power of all known auras at once.

skills.name: Master of Death
skills.description: Your mastery over death allows you to take full advantage of its abilities.

skills.name: Mana Overload
skills.description:
Increases your attack skills by overloading the mana flowing through you.
Right-click to lock activation effect.

skills.name: Aura Scythe
skills.description: Combine all of your auras and become a grim specter of death. While using Aura Scythe, aura type skills cannot be used. While a Battle Mage in your party is using Aura Scythe, you cannot use aura type skills, except for Weakening Aura or Aura Scythe. When Aura Scythe ends, the aura skill that was active before Aura Scythe was used reactivates automatically.

skills.description: Master the art of black magic and summon death itself to deal with your enemies. The summon duration gets longer as there are more souls to be sacrificed. The god of death's attack deals damage to enemies even when they are under attack reflection.

skills.name: Abyssal Lightning
skills.description:
Immerse your surroundings in dark magic and call upon netherworld lightning. When Dark Shock is activated, or an attack caused by Dark Brand is activated, netherworld lightning attacks the area.
Creates a netherworld passage around the Battle Mage periodically. Pressing a directional button will teleport you to the nearest passage in that direction, then close that passage. During your teleportation, Dark Shock manifests and attacks.
During Abyssal Lightning, the Dark Brand will last through a greater number of attacks.

skills.name: HEXA Condemnation
skills.description:
Seals a pact with a dark spirit. The dark spirit follows you around and after collecting a certain amount of souls, they will reveal themselves to deal a wide-range attack.
The dark spirit collects the souls of each enemy defeated by its attack and Ambassador Scythe. When a large amount of souls are collected, they are consumed to unleash the dark spirit's full power.
The dark spirit's attacks are unaffected by attack reflection.
Can be toggled On/Off

skills.name: HEXA Finishing Blow
skills.description: Quickly attack multiple enemies 6 times.\nBy combining your auras and becoming the ultimate specter of death, Ambassador Scythe's damage and attack range is enhanced.

skills.name: HEXA Sweeping Staff
skills.description: Summons a magic staff to sweep out the enemies and cause an explosion.

skills.name: HEXA Dark Shock
skills.description: While this skill is active, using Combat Teleport will create a streak of black lightning between your starting and ending positions, marking hit enemies with a Dark Brand.\nA Dark Brand is also marked when Dark Chain and Battle Burst are used, the marking skill and minions don't trigger the mark. Every time the mark is triggered more than a certain number of times, additional Dark Pentacles are triggered.\nCan be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: HEXA Dark Genesis
skills.description: Use deadly lightning to hit and temporarily stun multiple enemies. The power of the specter of death condenses over time to enhance to HEXA Dark Genesis: Death Whip. HEXA Dark Genesis: Death Whip does not receive the Dark Genesis - Cooldown Cutter effect. Unaffected by attack reflection. Additionally, when direct skill attacks land, there's a chance to deal damage to single enemies with Lightning Attack.\r\nPermanently increases HEXA Dark Shock's Dark Brand damage.

skills.name: HEXA Dark Genesis
skills.description: Uses Specter of Death Slash's deadly lightning to hit and temporarily stun multiple enemies. HEXA Dark Genesis: Death Whip does not receive the Dark Genesis - Cooldown Cutter effect and is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Crimson Pact
skills.description:
The dark spirit awakens fully to complete its bloody pact. The dark spirit's true appearance is revealed when the pact is complete, devouring all life. All attacks of Crimson Pact activate the Dark Brand from Dark Shock, and are unaffected by attack reflection.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +20%
Lv. 20 - Boss Damage: +20%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +30%, Boss Damage: +30%

skills.name: Duskbound Aura
skills.description:
Cloaks the battlefield in an aura of deepest darkness, drowning your enemies in the tenebrous energy of death.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%
